# IR-EMPOWER 2026

**Workshop on Infrared Emissivity Measurements — second edition**

| | |
|---|---|
| **Dates** | 28–29 September 2026 |
| **Venue** | Center for Applied Energy Research (CAE), Magdalene-Schoch-Str. 3, 97074 Würzburg, Germany |
| **Hosted by** | [CAE](/network/cae-wuerzburg.html) — Advanced Thermal Management group (Jochen Manara) |
| **Format** | Two days: 21 invited talks (25-minute slots, 20 min + 5 min discussion; two 50-minute plenaries), laboratory tour, two poster sessions, round table and Young Speaker Award |
| **Attendance** | About 40 participants from metrology institutes, research centres, universities and industry in Europe and the United States |
| **Official page** | [cae-zerocarbon.de/IR-Empower-Workshop.html](https://cae-zerocarbon.de/IR-Empower-Workshop.html) · [flyer & programme (PDF)](https://cae-zerocarbon.de/assets/files/IR-EMPOWER_2026_Flyer_new.pdf) |

The second IR-EMPOWER moves the series from Bilbao to Würzburg, keeping what
made the first edition work: a single topic — **how infrared emissivity is
measured, compared, modelled and used** — and a room small enough for every
talk to become a discussion. The programme runs from the national metrology
institutes (PTB, LNE) and high-temperature facilities (CEMHTI, JRC, CAE) to
additive manufacturing, construction materials, spacecraft coatings, and open
data. The two plenaries come from the series' founding group at
[UPV/EHU](/network/thermomat-ehu.html) and from
[LTeN-CNRS](/network/lten-cnrs.html), coordinator of the French research network
[TAMARYS](/network/networks/tamarys.html).

## From the Bilbao group

The Thermomat / HAIRL group at UPV/EHU, which founded the series, contributes
two talks and three posters:

- **Plenary** — *New upgrades on the emissivity measurement setup at UPV/EHU*,
  Iñigo González de Arrieta, opening the scientific programme on Monday morning.
- **Talk** — [*EKHI: the open database of optical and radiative data*](/data/ekhi.html),
  Jon Gabirondo-López: two years after the 2024 talk that proposed it, the
  database this site indexes.

## Round table

The workshop closes on Tuesday afternoon with a round table on how the
community should develop. The agenda set by the organisers covers four themes:

1. **Young Speaker Award** — announced during the session.
2. **Developing the community** — this website, mailing lists and a newsletter,
   visibility, intercomparison measurements and round-robin tests, and data
   collection.
3. **Collaborations** — networking, joint funding (for example COST Actions and
   Horizon Europe), thematic working groups, and links with groups worldwide.
4. **The future of IR-EMPOWER** — periodicity, format and venue of the next
   editions.

The outcomes will be summarised here after the workshop.

## Young Speaker Award

As in 2024, the Young Speaker Award recognises the best contribution by a
doctoral researcher. The winner will be announced at the round table on
29 September and listed here.

## The series

IR-EMPOWER 2026 is the second edition. The first,
[IR-EMPOWER 2024](/ir-empower/2024/index.html), was held at Bizkaia Aretoa in
Bilbao on 5–6 September 2024. See [all editions](/ir-empower/index.html).
